text:
Maya (CEO): quick follow-up from today's all-hands — thanks for the thoughtful Q&A. starting a short thread to capture the RCA link and clear owners for the reliability items. RCA (internal): https://redwood.internal/rcas/2026-04-12/route-weight-regression

Asha (engineering lead): summary in the doc: a route-weight rollout misaligned with batch-size heuristics, causing transient tail latency for some dedicated pools. mitigation: pause rollout + revert weights. full runbook and timeline in RCA.

Ben (SRE): i'll own the verified rollback and the rollout gate. plan: scripted preflight -> canary 5% -> 25% -> 100% with 30m windows and automated rollback on p95 increase > 20%. posting runbook link shortly.

Tomas (product): PM ask: short Console timeline blurb + a one-line FAQ for support. Lina, want to pair on customer messaging?

Lina (support): yes — need the affected org export and the exact impact window to craft targeted outreach. Asha / Ben, can you paste that here?

Asha (engineering lead): impact excerpt from RCA: "~18 minutes of elevated tail latency impacting ~6% of dedicated-routing requests between 09:12–09:30 UTC; temporary rollback applied." i'll DM org export to support.

Ben (SRE): preflight script added: https://redwood.internal/tools/weight-preflight.sh. basic checks: per-route p99 < baseline, KV miss ratio stable. please review.

inc-bot: deploy paused by Ben — canary rollout halted (canary=5%) due to observed p99 delta.

Tomas (product): proposing Console line: "Brief latency spike for a subset of routed traffic; engineers rolled back the change and are adding safeguards." Lina ok with that?

Lina (support): good starting point. i'll tailor outreach once i have the org list. ETA for email draft: today EOD.

Asha (engineering lead): ops actions in RCA checklist: Ben (rollback + preflight) ETA: today; Platform (dashboards for route_weight and per-route p95) ETA: 48h; Product/Support (console blurb + customer emails) ETA: EOD. please confirm here so i can mark items in-progress.

Ben (SRE): confirmed. posting the runbook snippet now.

Maya (CEO): leadership request: schedule a 30-minute blameless review next week to walk timeline and lessons. Asha, Ben please coordinate and include deploy metadata.

Asha (engineering lead): will schedule and attach logs. closing note: RCA is the single source for follow-ups — ping me if blocked.

Tomas (product): thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
